entries.title: Zephaniah 3:1
segments: ¶Woe to her who is rebellious and polluted, To the oppressing city!

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:2
segments: She has not obeyed [His] voice, She has not received correction; She has not trusted in the LORD, She has not drawn near to her God.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:3
segments: Her princes in her midst [are] roaring lions; Her judges [are] evening wolves That leave not a bone till morning.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:4
segments: Her prophets are insolent, treacherous people; Her priests have polluted the sanctuary, They have done violence to the law.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:5
segments: The LORD [is] righteous in her midst, He will do no unrighteousness. Every morning He brings His justice to light; He never fails, But the unjust knows no shame.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:6
segments: "I have cut off nations, Their fortresses are devastated; I have made their streets desolate, With none passing by. Their cities are destroyed; [There is] no one, no inhabitant.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:7
segments: I said, 'Surely you will fear Me, You will receive instruction' -So that her dwelling would not be cut off, [Despite] everything for which I punished her. But they rose early and corrupted all their deeds.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:8
segments: ¶"Therefore wait for Me," says the LORD, "Until the day I rise up for plunder; My determination [is] to gather the nations To My assembly of kingdoms, To pour on them My indignation, All my fierce anger; All the earth shall be devoured With the fire of My jealousy.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:9
segments: "For then I will restore to the peoples a pure language, That they all may call on the name of the LORD, To serve Him with one accord.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:10
segments: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia My worshipers, The daughter of My dispersed ones, Shall bring My offering.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:11
segments: In that day you shall not be shamed for any of your deeds In which you transgress against Me; For then I will take away from your midst Those who rejoice in your pride, And you shall no longer be haughty In My holy mountain.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:12
segments: I will leave in your midst A meek and humble people, And they shall trust in the name of the LORD.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:13
segments: The remnant of Israel shall do no unrighteousness And speak no lies, Nor shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth; For they shall feed [their] flocks and lie down, And no one shall make [them] afraid."

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:14
segments: ¶Sing, O daughter of Zion! Shout, O Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all [your] heart, O daughter of Jerusalem!

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:15
segments: The LORD has taken away your judgments, He has cast out your enemy. The King of Israel, the LORD, [is] in your midst; You shall see disaster no more.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:16
segments: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem: "Do not fear; Zion, let not your hands be weak.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:17
segments: The LORD your God in your midst, The Mighty One, will save; He will rejoice over you with gladness, He will quiet [you] with His love, He will rejoice over you with singing."

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:18
segments: "I will gather those who sorrow over the appointed assembly, Who are among you, [To whom] its reproach [is] a burden.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:19
segments: Behold, at that time I will deal with all who afflict you; I will save the lame, And gather those who were driven out; I will appoint them for praise and fame In every land where they were put to shame.

entries.title: Zephaniah 3:20
segments: At that time I will bring you back, Even at the time I gather you; For I will give you fame and praise Among all the peoples of the earth, When I return your captives before your eyes," Says the LORD.
